email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with mild fatigue
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 84-year-old male patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their first dose of DemoZanix (dose: 1 tablet twice daily).
Treatment started on 2026-06-11.
Approximately 8 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild fatigue.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
R. Reyes (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter680@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
